The build

How it was made.

Every system on the AURA One was designed by the same small team, in the same building, to do one thing: make an electric motorcycle that rewards a real rider. Here is what is underneath the paint.

01 · Powertrain

Torque from the first millisecond.

The AURA-DRIVE is an oil-cooled axial-flux motor — the same architecture used in hypercars — making it shorter, lighter and denser than the radial motors most e-bikes use. Full torque is on tap the instant you twist the throttle, and it stays flat to 80 mph.

  • 110 kW peak, 65 kW continuous output
  • 408 lb-ft of torque at the crankshaft
  • 97.3% drivetrain efficiency, measured on the dyno
  • Single-speed reduction with a sealed wet clutch

02 · Energy

The battery is the frame.

Instead of hanging cells in a box, we made the 21.5 kWh pack a stressed member of the chassis. That removes weight, drops the centre of gravity to crankshaft height, and gives the AURA One its uncanny low-speed balance.

  • Liquid-cooled NMC cells, automotive grade
  • 171 miles EPA-equivalent, 89 miles at sustained 70 mph
  • 1,800 cycles to 80% capacity, 8-year warranty
  • IP67 sealed — ride it through the storm

03 · Finishes

Reactive colour, on demand.

The acid-lime accent system is a paint-and-anodise process you can spec across five bodies. Try it.

04 · Chassis

Suspension that thinks.

Front and rear, electronically-controlled dampers adjust 500 times a second. Sport firms the rear under throttle; Comfort soaks up broken city tarmac; Track lets you dial compression and rebound by the click in the AuraOS app.

  • Semi-active 43 mm inverted fork, 4.7 in travel
  • Monoshock with remote reservoir, full adjustability
  • Forged-aluminium swingarm, lap-tested at Anglesey
  • Radial 4-piston front calipers, regen-blended braking

05 · Software

AuraOS, over the air.

The bike gets better while it sleeps. Charge-aware navigation routes you past AuraDock stations, theft alerts ping your phone, and ride modes update over the air. Your circuit telemetry syncs to the app the moment you pit.

  • Over-the-air updates for ride modes and features
  • Charge-aware navigation with live range mapping
  • Circuit telemetry: lap times, lean angle, g-force
  • Geofencing, theft tracking and remote immobilise
